title: Premier Edition card database + First Timer scenario
instructions:
Implement the Premier Edition card database + First Timer scenario config in game-core/src/data/cards.ts (pure data — NO engine logic, NO classes). This is the REAL card data the engine consumes via setup(setup, cards, piles). Every value below was researched from the official rulebook + fandom per-card pages; transcribe EXACTLY. Where a value is marked TODO(verify) in a comment, keep the given number but add the comment — do not omit the field.

Imports (exact, and ONLY this):
```ts
import type { CardDef, CardBonuses } from '../types';
```
The file must export EXACTLY these five things (no default export):

1) `export const PREMIER_CARDS: ReadonlyArray<CardDef> = [ ... ];` — ALL 61 cards: 10 characters, 16 weapons, 3 ammunition, 12 actions, 3 items, 15 infected, 2 tokens. Every card MUST have: id, name, type, set: 'premier', text (short rules text — one clause), copies (exact value below). Include ONLY the fields that apply per type (cost for buyable, bonuses where printed, ammoReq/damage/weaponEffects/weaponTags for weapons, hp/attack/decorations/infectedEffects for infected, maxHp/level2At/levels/abilities for characters, itemEffects for items, actionEffects for actions, tokenEffects for tokens). ORDER: characters ch-001..ch-010, then weapons we-001..we-016, then ammunition am-001..am-003, then actions ac-001..ac-012, then items it-001..it-003, then infected ma-001..ma-011 (SKIP ma-012/ma-013 — they are the tokens), then ma-014..ma-017, then the 2 tokens ma-012, ma-013 at the END.

2) `export const FIRST_TIMER_PILES: ReadonlyArray<{ pileId: string; cardIds: readonly string[] }> = [ ... ];` — EXACTLY 18 piles, ids and contents as listed below (combined piles are pre-shuffled at setup; order of cardIds inside does not matter).

3) `export const STARTING_DECK: ReadonlyArray<{ cardId: string; count: number }> = [ { cardId: 'am-001', count: 7 }, { cardId: 'we-009', count: 1 }, { cardId: 'we-004', count: 2 } ];` — the First Timer starting inventory (7 Ammo x10 + 1 Handgun + 2 Combat Knife).

4) `export const MANSION_EXTRA_ITEM_IDS: readonly string[] = ['it-002'];` — Yellow Herb goes in the Mansion, not the market (the engine adds these ids to the Mansion deck).

5) `export const FIRST_TIMER_SCENARIO_ID = 'firstTimer';` (plain typed string const).

----------------- STYLE/tsc rules -----------------
Strict TS with noUncheckedIndexedAccess is ON: every array index read in the test file must be guarded (`x[0] === undefined ? <fallback> : ...` or plain asserts that DON'T touch possibly-undefined). No `any`. No mutation. `text` values: single-line, use regular string literals (no template literals needed). Data file must compile with `npx tsc --noEmit` in game-core/ and must NOT import from any engine file (only ../types). The test file may import ONLY from '../types', './cards', and vitest globals.
